name: megascenes-halloween-costume
description: Try a Halloween look on your own selfie in your MegaScenes library: the same face dressed as a witch, a vampire, a pirate or a friendly ghost, spooky and fun.

interface.longDescription:
Pick a selfie or a portrait of yourself from your MegaScenes library and describe the look in general terms: a witch with a pointed hat, a vintage vampire, a pirate captain, a skeleton, a space explorer. Choose the scene and the style if you like: a pumpkin patch at dusk, a haunted mansion, a foggy forest, a party with jack-o'-lanterns, as spooky cinematic, fun and colorful, a vintage movie poster or a moody photo. You get a picture that keeps your face, dressed up the way you described, portrait, square or tall for stories.

ChatGPT lists your recent photos, tells you what the picture needs and makes it in your MegaScenes account when you ask. The picture opens in the chat and stays in your library next to your photo.

To pick an outfit before the party, for your Halloween post and profile pictures.

Limitations: only from a selfie or portrait of yourself, never of a famous person; no swimwear, underwear or sensual shots. Spooky, not gory, and looks described in general terms, not characters or brands owned by others. The photo must already be in your MegaScenes library; attachments from the chat are not passed to the plugin. Making a file needs a signed-in MegaScenes account and runs in it; nothing is made until you confirm. Not for sexual or adult content. Files are made by generative models and saved in your MegaScenes library.
capabilities: List the photos in your library
Dress you up in a spooky Halloween look
Return the photo in the chat
defaultPrompt: Make a Halloween photo of me as a witch with a pointed hat from my latest MegaScenes selfie
Put me in a haunted mansion as a vintage vampire
Create a fun photo of me as a pirate captain in a pumpkin patch at dusk

positive.prompt: Which photos do I have in my MegaScenes library?
positive.expected_behavior: The latest images of the signed-in account with their asset ids. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: Make a Halloween photo of me as a friendly ghost in a foggy forest from the selfie I uploaded to my MegaScenes library. Tell me what it needs, but don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one Halloween costume photo needs from the account. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: Which models can make a Halloween costume photo here?
positive.expected_behavior: The Halloween costume photo models with their settings. Nothing is created.

positive.description: Make it after an explicit request
positive.prompt: Make a spooky cinematic photo of me as a skeleton at a party with jack-o'-lanterns from the selfie I uploaded to my MegaScenes library. Go ahead and make it now.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT says what the run needs and, once the person confirms, one job starts in the signed-in MegaScenes account; the status tool reports progress and, when it succeeds, returns the file link, which the result view shows.

positive.prompt: Which MegaScenes account am I signed in with?
positive.expected_behavior: The email and plan of the signed-in account. Nothing is created.

negative.prompt: Print my Halloween photo on 50 mugs and ship them to my office in Berlin.
Email my Halloween photo to my client at sam@example.com.
What is the capital of Portugal?

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. Making a file runs in the user's existing MegaScenes account; no purchase happens in the conversation.

publication.release_notes: First release: make the file in the connected MegaScenes account and get it back in the conversation.
